# Third-Party Material

`XilinxBoardStore/boards/TUL/pynq-z2/A.0` is the PYNQ-Z2 board definition from
the AMD/Xilinx Board Store at commit
`12db223623433fda5981fe85308878d0e390fcc9`. It is used only to configure the
real TUL PYNQ-Z2 processing system, DDR, MIO, and board interfaces in Vivado.

The upstream source is <https://github.com/Xilinx/XilinxBoardStore>. Its
license is preserved in `XilinxBoardStore/LICENSE`.
